Edition match: The cover credits Yu-Chen Tseng and Eros Lin and carries the EmperorS4 logo; its gondolier and 3D houses identify the 2015 strategy game. The publisher's Burano page at https://en.emperors4.com/game/burano and 2015 English manual at https://www.spiele-offensive.de/gfx/cf/burano/rules_en.pdf corroborate the edition, distinct from Walking in Burano.. firstPlayerRule: Whoever visited Italy most recently starts. If nobody has ever been there, choose the starting player randomly.
clarifications: The initial cube-pyramid construction is simultaneous; the selected player leads the player-turn phase.
This is Burano, the cube-pyramid game, rather than Walking in Burano.
